note_en: 甚至连…也… means "even… (still)…": 甚至连很少吃羊肉的人，也会被这里的羊肉泡馍吸引 "Even people who rarely eat mutton are won over by the yangrou paomo here." 连 marks the surprising item and 也 (or 都) must follow before the verb; 甚至 ("even") adds extra emphasis. English needs only "even," but Chinese uses the frame.
